name: Plan -> Execute -> Verify
description: A scaffold that asks the model to plan, produce the answer, then verify the answer against the task schema and requirements.
evidence_controls: Final output is evaluated by deterministic metrics.
Token usage is preserved for cost calculation.
Verification phase must not invent facts outside the scenario.
overreach_risks: The verification phase may rationalize unsupported output instead of correcting it.
The plan may add requirements not present in the scenario.
limitations: This scaffold can improve structure without guaranteeing factual correctness.
It should be compared on named scenarios, not treated as generally superior.
